_comment: go-harness settings. Every key is optional; missing keys use the defaults in scripts/harness/lib.mjs. See dev-docs/harness/go-harness.md.
_merge: human = the harness never merges. auto = the harness merges a story when CI is green on a branch up to date with main, the review has no open must, the budget held and no existing fm-api type changed (outside contract_epics). Tracks in auto_merge.exclude_tracks always wait for a human; the lane goes on meanwhile.
_auto_merge: exclude_tracks: tracks a human always merges. max_branch_updates: how often the harness brings a PR up to date with main (then CI again) before it gives up. max_syncs: how often the sync stage may resolve conflicts with main for one story before it is blocked.
_idle: A lane with nothing to start while the other lane still works waits poll_min minutes and asks the picker again, for at most max_hours. Nothing in flight anywhere -> the lane ends. -NoIdleWait ends it at once.
_main_red: Main red at the merge gate: the harness re-runs the failed main jobs once (a flaky test), then checks every poll_min minutes for at most max_hours before it stops the lane.
_budget: Per-story budget in USD = size factor x base. S = 1x, M = 2.5x, L = 5x. A story over budget stops with harness:blocked.
_lane_max_unmerged: merge: human only. How many ready PRs a lane may leave waiting for a human merge before it stops picking new stories.

review._model: Model for the review lens subagents: inherit (same as the run), sonnet, opus or fable.

_contract_epics: Epics in which a change to an existing fm-api request/response type is expected. Anywhere else it stops the story for a human.
_bot_login: GitHub login the harness assigns stories to. Empty = the login gh is authenticated as.
